sentences.text:
Yogesh Sharma And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on
19 January, 2023

Author: Rajiv Gupta
Bench: Rajiv Gupta
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 65
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 24810 of 2022

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Applicant :- Yogesh Sharma And 2 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Amul Kumar Tyagi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Prabhakar Dwivedi

Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Prabhakar Dwivedi, learned counsel for the opposite
party no.2, learned Aga for the State and perused the record.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the prayer to quash the charge sheet dated 24.1.2021 and cognizance order dated 24.2.2021 as well as entire criminal proceedings of S.T.
No. 590 of 2022 (State vs. Yogesh Sharma and others) arising out of Case Crime No. 549 of 2020,
under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 307 IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station- Hapur Nagar,
District- Hapur, pending in the court of District and Sessions Judge, Hapur.

entities.text:
S.T.
No. 590 of 2022 (State vs. Yogesh Sharma and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: court of District and Sessions Judge, Hapur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that opposite party No. 2 is the wife of applicant No. 1 and daughter in-law of applicant Nos. 2 and 3 and on account of matrimonial discord, the instant criminal case was instituted against the applicants, however with the intervention of the Yogesh Sharma And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95833476/
1 respected members of both the families, parties have amicably settled all their disputes and differences and now they do not have any grievance against each other.

entities.text: Yogesh Sharma And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicants has next submitted that husband and wife have have re-united and are living together and leading a happy married life.
Learned counsel for the applicants has next submitted that in view of the compromise made between the parties, the entire criminal proceedings against the applicants be quashed.

Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 has also appeared and has acknowledged the said compromise and reiterated the fact that the parties have already settled all their disputes and husband and wife have re-united and leading a happy married life.
In the backdrop of the said circumstances, the opposite party No. 2 has no objection if the entire proceedings are quashed.

This Court is not unmindful of the judgements of the Apex Court in the cases of :-
1. B.S. Joshi and others Vs. State of Haryana and another (2003) 4 SCC 675.
2. Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation [2008) 9 SCC 677].
3. Manoj Sharma Vs. State and others ( 2008) 16 SCC 1.
4. Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab (2012) 10 SCC 303.
5. Narindra Singh and others Vs. State of Punjab ( 2014) 6 SCC 466.
Wherein the Apex Court has categorically held that compromise can be made between the parties even in respect of certain cognizable and non compoundable offences.

sentences.text:
Reference may also be made to the decision given by this Court in Shaifullah and others Vs. State of U.P. and another [2013 (83)
ACC 278], in which the law expounded by the Apex court in the aforesaid cases has been explained in detail.

sentences.text: Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, as noted herein above, and also the submissions made by the counsel for the parties, the court is of the considered opinion that no useful purpose shall be served by prolonging the proceedings of the above mentioned case.

Accordingly, the entire proceedings of S.T. No. 590 of 2022 (State vs. Yogesh Sharma and others)
arising out of Case Crime No. 549 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 307 IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station- Hapur Nagar, District- Hapur, pending in the court of District and Sessions Judge, Hapur, are hereby quashed.
